mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, higher discount rates applied to future cash flows reduce the present value of expected corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified FEDFUNDS increase (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS rise is <0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment growth) of at least 50,000 jobs coincides with stronger consumer demand and corporate hiring, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥50,000 in the following month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative despite PAYEMS increase ≥50,000 (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (industrial production) unexpectedly exceeds its prior month by 2%, it signals resilient manufacturing demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the production surprise (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of 5% suggests supply-side constraints, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during the INDPRO decline period.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market tightening, which raises expected equity valuations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE below 4.5% for two months (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly drop in RSAFS (retail sales) of over 10% signals consumer weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by >10% in the following month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the RSAFS drop.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and CPIAUCSL (inflation) by at least 2% and 0.5% respectively over the next quarter indicate a strong demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 ↑ ≥2% and CPIAUCSL ↑ ≥0.5% over the next quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the dual proxy increase.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the SPX 20-day forward return tends to be negative due to higher discounting of future cash flows, regardless of other indicators.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are consistently positive across multiple tightening episodes (p < 0.01).
